data.exact_reserve_text: During 2020, gross ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2018 and prior) increased by $0.6m ($1.9m net of reinsurance).

prior_year_events.impact_description: deteriorations coming primarily from the Casualty division, but also PFR and Aviation to a smaller extent, in respect of late deteriorating large losses.
better than expected experience on 2018 from some of the shorter tailed lines within the Technical Risks division and Accident & Health division.

named_events.loss_description: some deteriorations on mid-sized Aerospace losses early on in 2020.

direct COVID-19 claims exposure at this stage to be less than $2m net of reinsurance, as few claims have been notified to date, with many denied on coverage grounds. This exposure is monitored closely by the Syndicate's claims team. It is expected that the Syndicate will have some indirect exposure to COVID-19, with pandemic recessionary impacts expected to materialise to some extent on the Casualty classes of business.

data.standardized_narrative: In 2020, Syndicate 1919 experienced a net gross strengthening of $0.6 million in ultimate claims for prior underwriting years (2018 and prior). This was a mixed development, with deteriorations in older years (2017 and prior) primarily from the Casualty division, as well as Political Risk and Aviation due to late deteriorating large losses. These adverse movements were partially offset by favorable claims development in 2018 from shorter-tailed lines within the Technical Risks and Accident & Health divisions. COVID-19 contributed to uncertainties, though direct claims exposure was minimal, with potential indirect impacts on Casualty classes.

data.data_quality_notes: There is a significant discrepancy between the stated gross prior year development of $0.6m in the narrative and a calculation based on the gross claims development triangle, which suggests a strengthening of approximately $37.4m for 2018 and prior years. The narrative figure is used as it is a direct statement of the overall prior year development.
